questions.question: Why did this project exist (problem statement)?
questions.answer: Support and internal tools were hitting OLTP directly; needed read replica + caching layer with SLOs.

questions.question: What was uniquely yours on this project?
questions.answer: Designed read path, cache invalidation contract with Ledger team, and load tests.

questions.question: What metrics moved post-launch (or what qualitative signal confirmed success)?
questions.answer: p95 read latency 120ms→35ms; OLTP CPU down ~40% on support traffic.
